URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/south-asia/afghanistan-floods-nuristan-deaths-b3019198.html
The Independent (Stuti Mishra), Wed 22 Jul 2026 05:21 BST — Flash floods tore through Nuristan province, eastern Afghanistan, on Monday, killing at least 23 people and leaving more than 100 missing; 80 injured; undetermined number of buildings collapsed. Rescue crews digging through mud/rubble for a second day. Parun (provincial capital) among worst hit; toll expected to rise as teams reach cut-off villages (Afghanistan National Disaster Management Authority). Meteorology dept forecasts further heavy rain, thunderstorms and flash flooding in 10 of 34 provinces; urged people away from riverbanks. Context: Afghanistan among most disaster-exposed states; 113 killed in Nuristan floods 2021; 300+ in spring 2024; 110 earlier this year. Emergency response weakened since Taliban's 2021 return froze donor funding.
